summary: BMO 2025-5C12 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a servicing event affecting a single mortgage loan (Vertex HQ) held by the trust. The controlling class representative under the VRTX 2025-HQ trust and servicing agreement terminated Situs Holdings, LLC as special servicer and appointed Argentic Services Company LP as successor. This is a routine administrative servicing change, not a corporate special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or any strategic corporate action. It is a disclosure of operational servicing activity, so it falls outside special-situations categories.
